title_original: Robert Pattinson to be next James Bond

blocks.text: Robert Pattinson has been cast as the next James Bond, announced by Amazon MGM Studios.

Pattinson takes on the role of the British spy, created by author Ian Fleming. He follows Sean Connery, George Lazenby, Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton, Pierce Brosnan, and most recently Daniel Craig in the role.
Amazon announced the casting at shortly after 15.00 GMT on Monday, November 16, posting the below Instagram video.

blocks.text: Casting for the role began in May this year, under casting director Nina Gold. Denis Villeneuve will direct the 26 th James Bond film, produced by Amy Pascal and David Heyman for their Pascal Pictures and Heyday Films, written by Steven Knight, and executive produced by Tanya Lapointe.
It is the first James Bond film under the creative control of Amazon MGM, after the company bought the rights from Eon Productions in February 2025 at a reported cost of $1bn.

UK actor Pattinson was named a Screen UK-Ireland Star of Tomorrow in the second edition of the talent-spotting initiative, in 2005. He has since appeared in major franchises including Harry Potter as Cedric Diggory, leading Twilight as vampire Edward Cullen, and as the title role in The Batman .

The actor also has an extensive list of independent credits, including David Cronenberg’s Cosmopolis and Maps To The Stars , Brady Corbet’s The Childhood of a Leader , James Gray’s The Lost City of Z , the Safdie brothers’ Good Time , Claire Denis’ High Life , Robert Eggers’ The Lighthouse , Lynne Ramsay’s Die My Love , and Kristoffer Borgli’s The Drama .
He appeared in the latter this year, as well as in Christopher Nolan’s epic The Odyssey , and as Chris Hansen in Lance Oppenheim’s Primetime .
Pattinson has also worked with Villeneuve in the upcoming Dune: Part Three , scheduled for release on December 18 this year.

”James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime,” said Pattinson. ”I’m deeply grateful to Denis, Amy, David, Tanya, and everyone at Amazon MGM Studios for their belief in me. To say this role is a dream come true is an understatement. I couldn’t be more excited about this partnership and the work ahead with this fantastic team.”

“Today marks a defining moment for our studio and a significant milestone in the history of James Bond as we proudly introduce Robert Pattinson as the next 007,” said Mike Hopkins, head of Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios. ”This iconic character has captivated audiences around the world for more than six decades, and there’s no doubt that Robert’s remarkable range, magnetic screen presence, and quiet intensity make him an exceptional choice to carry that legacy forward.”

”I want to express my deep gratitude to the remarkable actors who joined us on this journey,” said Villeneuve, referring to the casting process. ”We were surrounded by extraordinary talent, but there can only be one 007. I am overjoyed to welcome Robert Pattinson as our new James Bond. He has the timeless soul of 007 and brings a spirit that is completely new. I cannot wait to begin.”

”James Bond is one of the most beloved, inspiring, iconic, and yet enigmatic characters in literature and movies,” said a statement from Pascal and Heyman. ”The legacy of this character is in great hands with Robert Pattinson. His fearlessness as an actor, his self-deprecating wit, and his ability to continually reinvent himself make him the perfect Bond for our times.”
